answer.summary: The API types check failed because the PR changed the backend EndpointOverviewOutput DTO (adding asset_external_reference and asset_last_seen_source) but did not regenerate openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts. The generator output differs from the committed file, so the job fails deterministically on every run. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result. A re-run will not help.
